values.quote: opens a one-way magical corridor through a piece of [[terrain]] in the target direction for 10 seconds

values.meaning: increased travel speed for Bard and allies through the portal
values.quote: '''Bard''' and allies travel through the portal at 33% increased speed.

mechanics.claim: Magical Journey does not deal damage or apply any debuff; it is a self/ally/enemy-usable one-way traversal effect through terrain.
mechanics.quote: Champions can enter by moving into the portal, however allies will be faster.
